rawContent: The one thing I hope #metoo and the firing of powerful men as a result of sexual molestation/assault/violence will achieve is to expand our imagination on what’s possible. There’s no such thing as too big/powerful to be let go. These men CAN be replaced. Things CAN change.

@afalli There were talking points that went ignored, folks flew off the handle and got personal... it wasn't a very good outing. It really helped me understand that social media anger doesn't always translate well to coordinated attempts at advocacy. We can learn a thing or two from #BLM
